title: Operation device for manual control of a load suspended in the operation device

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
features.quote: a handle ( 22 ), which is movably arranged in relation to the housing ( 20 ) and the load connection device ( 21 ) and which has a rest position between two end positions
features.note: The reference discloses a handle that is part of the operation device, but it does not explicitly state that the handle or grip portion is designed as a hollow body for gripping or for air passage.

features.item: An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.note: The reference describes an operation device for lifting and lowering a load, controlled by a sensor and control unit, but it does not mention an electrically operated vacuum generating device.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference does not disclose a vacuum generating device, nor the routing of exhaust air through a hollow grip portion.

features.item: A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping device.

features.item: A suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to the carrier plate extending around it
features.note: The reference describes an operation device for suspending a load, but it does not mention a suction plate or a seal.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip
features.note: The reference discloses a handle and a housing, but none of the other specified components like a hollow grip portion for air, vacuum generator, exhaust air routing, or sound-damping device.

features.item: Vacuum handling apparatus with suction plate and grip unit combined
features.note: The reference describes an operation device for manual control of a suspended load, but it does not specify it as a vacuum handling apparatus, nor does it mention a suction plate.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping material or lining for the grip portion.

features.item: Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.note: The reference does not disclose a vacuum generating device.

features.item: Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-reducing device or material.

features.item: Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
features.quote: an elongated guide for the handle has an upper end, which is fixedly attached to the housing, and a lower end, which is provided with the second connection device, that the handle concentrically surrounds the guide
features.note: The reference describes an elongated guide for the handle and the handle concentrically surrounding it, which could imply an elongated grip portion. However, it does not mention first and second housing portions or an air outlet on a second housing portion.

features.item: Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not mention an air collection screw or exhaust air.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
features.note: The reference does not mention air baffles or exhaust air.

features.item: Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not mention a battery coupling point, air baffles, or exhaust air.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference does not mention a suction plate or a releasable connection between a grip unit and a suction plate.

features.item: Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.note: The reference does not mention a suction opening, suction chamber, or suction plate.

claims.note: The reference describes an operation device for manual control of a suspended load, but not specifically a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device with a suction plate.

claims.quote: a housing ( 20 ); a first connection device ( 5 ), at least indirectly carried by the housing ( 20 ), for the connection of the operation device ( 2 ) to a device for the lifting and lowering
claims.note: The reference discloses a housing and a handle (grip portion) for manual control of a load, but it does not mention an electrically operated vacuum generating device within the housing.
The reference describes a housing and a handle, but does not specify that the grip portion is designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not disclose a vacuum generating device or the guidance of exhaust air through a grip portion to an air outlet.
The reference describes an operation device with a handle and a sensor, but it does not mention a sound-damping device arranged in a grip portion.
The reference does not describe a grip portion being lined with a sound-damping material.
The reference describes a housing and a control unit, but it does not specify a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion.
The reference does not mention a sound-reducing device or sound-reducing material in a housing portion.

This reference describes a handle that is movably arranged in relation to a housing, but it does not describe a grip portion elongated between a first and second housing portion, nor an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.
This reference does not disclose an air collection device, an air collection screw, or the collection of exhaust air upstream of a grip portion.
This reference does not describe air baffles for guiding exhaust air from a grip portion to an air outlet.

This reference does not disclose a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery on the housing, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a point.
The reference does not mention air baffles or directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.
The reference describes an 'operation device for manual control of a load suspended' but does not explicitly mention a 'vacuum handling apparatus'.
The reference does not describe a suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to and extending around it.
The reference describes an 'operation device' but does not refer to it as a 'grip unit according to claim 1' of the subject invention.
This reference does not describe a grip unit and suction plate being releasably connected via a coupling device.
This reference does not describe a grip unit having a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber to generate a vacuum between a suction plate and an object.

overall.why: The reference describes an operation device with a handle, housing, sensor, and control unit for lifting and lowering a load, which is a very broad concept. However, it lacks specific details about vacuum generation, suction plates, air routing, and sound damping that are central to the subject inve
